title: GA Exporter — KPI Monitoring Schema
description: Structured data extracted from Annex 1 Part B (Impact / Communication & Dissemination measures, expected outcomes with scale/significance) used to fill the KPI Excel template. The GA is a planning document, so 'achieved' and 'monthlyValues' are extracted as empty/zero placeholders — they exist only so the generated workbook has the right shape for the project team to fill in during execution.

totalMonths.description: Drives the number of monthly tracking columns per KPI (grouped visually into YEAR 1 / YEAR 2 / ... blocks of 12).

categories.description: One category per KPI Excel sheet/tab.

name.description: Must be the Grant Agreement's own heading/label for this indicator block, copied verbatim (e.g. 'EXPECTED OUTCOME #1', or the 'TOOL' column value from a Communication and Dissemination Indicators table such as 'Social Media', 'Website'). Do not paraphrase, summarize or invent a friendlier name — re-running extraction on the same GA text must produce the same category names, so downstream consumers (backend, frontend, repeated regenerations) can rely on category identity being stable.

groups.description: One or more sub-groupings of KPIs within this category, mirroring the GA/template's own nesting (e.g. a '[C6.1]Twitter' bracket-coded sub-heading with its own rows below it). When the category has no natural sub-grouping (e.g. a flat list of 'Scale:' bullet points under one Expected Outcome), return a single group with no 'label'.

label.description: The bracketed/verbatim sub-heading this group of KPIs is nested under (e.g. '[C6.1]Twitter'), copied the same way as categories[].name. Omit entirely for an ungrouped category's single implicit group.

code.description: GA impact-indicator bracket code this KPI traces back to, e.g. '[C6.1]', '[D1]'. Optional — not every KPI row has one in the GA.

target.description: Target as stated in the GA — kept as free text since targets are often qualitative/compound (e.g. '>1000 followers', 'Y1: >1500 entries'). 'tbd' if this indicator is named but no numeric/qualitative target is stated.

unit.description: Optional normalized unit if the target is a plain count, e.g. 'count', 'minutes'.

achieved.description: Running total; always 0 at generation time, computed later from monthlyValues.

monthlyValues.description: One entry per month of totalMonths, initialized to null; filled in by the project team during monitoring.
